sections.text: Delivered orders can be refunded for damaged, defective or not-as-described items within 30 days of delivery. Requests after 30 days are not eligible for a refund, but the customer may be offered a repair or replacement review by the care team.

sections.text: Support can approve refunds up to 100 USD per order immediately. Refunds above 100 USD are submitted for approval by a human care lead, who replies within one business day. The refund total can never exceed what the customer paid minus refunds already issued.
